title: Heterobimetallic uranyl(VI) alkoxides of lanthanoids: formation through simple ligand exchange

material_class.structural_family: discrete Ln2UO2 tert-butoxide with terminal THF

synthesis.procedure: Under argon, 70.4 mg SmN''3 (0.111 mmol, 2.0 equiv.) in 3 mL benzene was added dropwise to a suspension of 41.0 mg dried [UO2(N'')2(THF)2] (0.056 mmol, 1.0 equiv.) in 1 mL benzene. The mixture was stirred for 1 h at room temperature, 100 mg HOtBu (1.349 mmol, 24.1 equiv.) was added, and stirring was continued for 4 h. Volatiles were removed under reduced pressure to give an orange oil. Crystals were grown from saturated benzene at 5 °C. N'' = N(SiMe3)2.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: argon glovebox or Schlenk; benzene solution
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Remove volatiles under reduced pressure; crystallize from saturated benzene at 5 °C.

material_class.structural_family: acetate-bridged dimer of Ln2UO2 tert-butoxide triangles

synthesis.procedure: Under argon, 1.670 g NdN''3 (2.660 mmol, 4.0 equiv.) in 30 mL toluene was added dropwise to a suspension of 0.520 g dried UO2(OAc)2 (1.330 mmol, 2.0 equiv.) in 10 mL THF. After 1 h at room temperature, with no undissolved UO2(OAc)2 remaining, 1.084 g HOtBu (14.630 mmol, 33.0 equiv.) was added and stirring continued for 4 h. Volatiles were removed under reduced pressure to give a bright orange solid. Crystals were grown from saturated toluene at 5 °C. The crystal contains two benzene-equivalent lattice solvent molecules in the deposited model (C72H144).
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Remove volatiles under reduced pressure; crystallize from saturated toluene at 5 °C.

properties.summary: Paramagnetic Curie–Weiss behaviour with μeff matching Gd(III) only; negative Weiss constant indicates antiferromagnetic interactions, with any ordering below the 2.1 K limit. UV-vis shows bands at 270, 362 and 450 nm, the last a weak charge-transfer band hypsochromically shifted relative to typical uranyl spectra.

material_class.structural_family: acetate-bridged dimer of Ln2UO2 tert-butoxide triangles

synthesis.procedure: Under argon, 233.1 mg HoN''3 (0.361 mmol, 4.0 equiv.) in 5 mL benzene was added dropwise to a suspension of 70.0 mg dried UO2(OAc)2 (0.180 mmol, 2.0 equiv.) in 1 mL THF. After 1 h at room temperature, with no residual UO2(OAc)2, 146.8 mg HOtBu (1.980 mmol, 22.0 equiv.) was added and stirring continued for 4 h. Removal of volatiles gave a bright orange solid in 75% yield calculated as the dimer (158.0 mg, 0.067 mmol). Crystallisation from saturated benzene at 5 °C produced both dimer 2-Ho and trimer 3-Ho, which were crystallographically distinguishable but not separated in bulk.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Remove volatiles; crystallize from saturated benzene at 5 °C, co-crystallising 2-Ho and 3-Ho.
synthesis.yield: 75% as dimer (158.0 mg, 0.067 mmol); not separated from 3-Ho

properties.summary: Paramagnetic with μeff matching Ho(III). Negative Weiss constant and χmol flattening below 4 K indicate antiferromagnetic ordering; magnetisation saturates near 5 μB, about half of gJJ = 10. UV-vis bands at 275, 362 and 450 nm; the 275 nm absorption decreases on exposure to atmospheric moisture.

material_class.structural_family: acetate-bridged dimer of Ln2UO2 tert-butoxide triangles

synthesis.procedure: Under argon, 33.3 mg ErN''3 (0.052 mmol, 2.0 equiv.) in 5 mL benzene was added dropwise to a suspension of 10.8 mg dried UO2(OAc)2 (0.026 mmol, 1.0 equiv.) in 1 mL THF. After 1 h at room temperature, with no residual UO2(OAc)2, 134.0 mg HOtBu (1.808 mmol, 70.0 equiv.) was added and stirring continued for 4 h. Volatiles were removed to give a bright orange solid. Connectivity was seen by SXRD, but disorder prevented a refined model and no CCDC entry is given.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Remove volatiles under reduced pressure. SXRD connectivity only; no refined structure.

material_class.structural_family: acetate-bridged trimer of Ln2UO2 tert-butoxide triangles

synthesis.procedure: Isolated from the same reaction as 2-Ho: 70.0 mg dried UO2(OAc)2 (0.180 mmol, 2.0 equiv.) in 1 mL THF, 233.1 mg HoN''3 (0.361 mmol, 4.0 equiv.) in 5 mL benzene, 1 h at room temperature, then 146.8 mg HOtBu (1.980 mmol, 22.0 equiv.), 4 h. Crystallisation from saturated benzene at 5 °C, especially over longer times, gave the acetate-bridged trimer together with the dimer; the crystals were not synthetically separated. Cubic Pa-3.
synthesis.time: 1 h, then 4 h; longer crystallisation favours higher oligomers
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Co-crystallised with 2-Ho from saturated benzene at 5 °C; not separated.

material_class.structural_family: uranyl capped on a chloride-containing Ln3 tert-butoxide with one aqua ligand

synthesis.procedure: The main text states that 1/3 equiv. of hydrated LnCl3·6H2O was added to sublimed LnN''3 to supply 1 equiv. of chloride. In the SI, under argon, 250.9 mg DyN''3 (0.390 mmol, 2.67 equiv.) and 18.2 mg DyCl3·6H2O (0.048 mmol, 0.33 equiv.) in 3 mL benzene were added dropwise to 107.1 mg [UO2(N'')2(THF)2] (0.146 mmol, 1.0 equiv.) in 2 mL benzene. After 1 h at room temperature, 210 mg HOtBu (2.833 mmol, 19.4 equiv.) was added and stirring continued for 4 h. Volatiles were removed to give a bright orange solid. Crystals were grown from saturated benzene at 5 °C (Pnma). Water from the hydrate is required; the complex was not isolated when water was excluded.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Remove volatiles under reduced pressure; crystallize from saturated benzene at 5 °C.

In the SI, under argon, 73.8 mg HoN''3 (0.114 mmol, 2.0 equiv.) and 11.4 mg KN'' (0.057 mmol, 1.0 equiv.) in 2 mL benzene were added dropwise to 42.0 mg [UO2(N'')2(THF)2] (0.057 mmol, 1.0 equiv.) in 2 mL benzene.
